## Biography

John Ermitage is the founder and elder strategist of the Distant Worlds 3 expedition. An elderly man with tinted blue glasses and a calm, stern bearing, he was brought out of semi-stasis to direct the expedition's route toward the Orion region. He is an old friend of Cal and maintains deep connections to pre-Federation space history, including the disintegration of GalCop and early Alliance exploration efforts. Ermitage distrusts modern COVAS systems, preferring older technologies, and flies a vintage Lanner-class vessel. He orchestrated much of DW3's hidden agenda, including the investigation of witch-space anomalies and the recovery of ancient technology.
